newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bus, trucks collide on Brazil highway, six dead.
newsitem.headline: Bus, trucks collide on Brazil highway, six dead.

text.p: Six people were killed and 15 injured when a bus and two trucks collided on a busy highway near Sao Paulo on Thursday, a police spokesman said.
A truck crossed the central barrier and smashed into the bus, coming in the opposite direction. Another truck ploughed into the back of the bus, the spokesman said.
The drivers of the first truck and the bus were among the dead.
